# DERIVESTsuite subset

This directory contains an unmodified subset of DERIVESTsuite version 1.6
by John D'Errico:

- `jacobianest.m`
- `gradest.m`
- `derivest.m`

The files were obtained from the official MathWorks File Exchange archive:

https://www.mathworks.com/matlabcentral/fileexchange/13490-adaptive-robust-numerical-differentiation

Only the routines required by SAGE Project 1 are redistributed. The
original BSD-style terms are retained verbatim in `LICENSE.txt`.
